checks.requirement: Versioned fixed-UTC selection, skip/coalesce, expiry and stable occurrence identity
Duplicate ticks, transaction retries, atomic rollback and compact outstanding history
Private native schema and conservative generic lifecycle recognition
Scoped service authorization, edit, pause/resume, credential rotation, revocation and overlap
Optional pinned supervised producer, readiness, process restart and full drain
Exact paused independently reviewed native authority profile and retained schema recovery
Populated upgrade, history-delta refusal, fresh restore, separate resume and explicit repair without duplicate occurrence
Host regressions, unchanged public contracts and owned Docker retirement

host_regression.skip: Existing Windows source/data symlink case; unchanged startup retains prior Linux qualification

qualification_boundary: Single-site trusted native fixed-UTC recurrence, at most one optional producer and one outstanding occurrence per schedule. Coordinated history and explicit credential repair only. No catch-up backlog, calendar rules, remote effect merge, multi-host autoscaler or provider claim.
